name: Gertrude

sources.name: ERA5 hourly single levels (Copernicus C3S/ECMWF; NSF NCAR ds633.0, ARCO-ERA5)

era5VsBestTrack.method: ERA5 max 10 m wind within 2 deg of the hourly best-track centre, compared with the best-track sustained wind (JTWC 1-min, JMA 10-min) at the same hour

era5Note: Wind and rain fields are ERA5 reanalysis (about 28 km grid). For intense typhoons it smooths the eye wall: the strongest ERA5 10 m wind near the centre is typically a third to a half of the best-track estimate, and its central pressure is tens of hPa too high. Use the best-track intensity (with its agency and averaging period) for peak strength, and the field for spatial extent and timing. Each storm's summary.json carries its own ERA5-vs-best-track ratios.
